decisions.reason: After four years and no website presence in 2020–2021, the citrus-specific crate appears to have yielded enough negative information that its option value is largely exhausted despite its earlier strategic importance.

A stackable plastic crate line sits close to the firm's core reusable-packaging business and can likely be kept at modest incremental cost while serving standard customer needs even with reduced visibility.

The spill-retention pallet is a more peripheral niche application, and after several years without observed promotion the firm would likely reallocate resources to stronger core lines and new development.
This pallet variant still leverages established pallet capabilities and customer relationships, so the cost of keeping the option open is relatively low compared with dropping it outright.
